definitions.explanation: A person who deliberately sets fire to property. Used in news reports and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: {放火犯|ほうかはん}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
{警察|けいさつ}は{放火犯|ほうかはん}の{行方|ゆくえ}を{追|お}っている。
examples.english: The police are tracking down the arsonist.

examples.japanese: {連続|れんぞく}{放火犯|ほうかはん}による{被害|ひがい}が{相次|あいつ}いで、{住民|じゅうみん}は{不安|ふあん}を{感|かん}じている。
examples.english: Damage from a serial arsonist has been occurring one after another, and residents are feeling uneasy.

notes:
A compound of {放火|ほうか} (arson; setting fire) and {犯|はん} (criminal/perpetrator). {放火|ほうか} itself is a serious crime under Japanese law, classified alongside murder as one of the most severely punished offenses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放火犯|ほうかはん}を{逮捕|たいほ}する — to arrest an arsonist
- {連続|れんぞく}{放火犯|ほうかはん} — serial arsonist
- {放火犯|ほうかはん}を{捕|つか}まえる — to catch an arsonist

RELATED WORDS:
- {放火|ほうか} — arson (the act itself)
- {放火|ほうか}する — to commit arson
- {失火|しっか} — accidental fire (as opposed to deliberate arson)
- {火災|かさい} — fire (general term for fires, whether accidental or deliberate)
